nodes.label: HIIT Interval Timer App (Interval Pulse Timer)
nodes.rationale: Native SwiftUI rewrite of a former Expo/React Native app; behavior is deliberately preserved screen-for-screen. All data is local-only (SwiftData) with no accounts and no network.

nodes.label: XcodeGen Project Generation
nodes.rationale: The .xcodeproj is git-ignored and regenerated from project.yml, never edited by hand; xcodegen generate must be re-run after adding/removing/renaming source files or they won't be in the project. Side effect: IDE/SourceKit shows false 'Cannot find X in scope' errors, so trust xcodebuild output.

nodes.label: SwiftData Local-Only Persistence
nodes.rationale: All workouts and session history live in on-device SwiftData; the app wipes and recreates the store if a schema change makes it unloadable, as a dev convenience.

nodes.label: TimerEngine Timestamp-Based Design
nodes.rationale: Elapsed time is always recomputed from Date() minus accumulated pause time so pauses/stalls never drift; the 100ms Timer only triggers sync(). Callbacks (onSegmentChange, onCountdownTick last 3s, onFinish) mirror the original RN engine.

nodes.label: flattenWorkout Segment Expansion (TimerEngineMath)
nodes.rationale: Pure, unit-tested: expands rounds plus optional pre-roll/warm-up/cool-down into Segments with cumulative startsAt. Non-round segments use round: 0 and intervalIndex: -1 so the ring hides the round counter. An elapsed exactly on a segment edge belongs to the next segment.

nodes.label: Workout Domain ID Named uuid
nodes.rationale: The domain id field is named uuid, not id, to avoid clashing with SwiftData/Identifiable.

nodes.label: Workout order Field for Manual Sort
nodes.rationale: SwiftData has no inherent order, so an explicit order field gives the Workouts list a manual sort; drag-reordering rewrites it.

nodes.label: Cues Audio/Haptics Singleton
nodes.rationale: Pooled AVAudioPlayers replayed via currentTime = 0, AVAudioSession(.playback, .mixWithOthers) so cues play in Silent Mode, plus UIImpact/UINotificationFeedbackGenerator haptics. initialize()/release() tied to run-screen appear/disappear; previewAlert plays even when sound cues are off.

nodes.label: seedIfNeeded First-Launch Sample Workouts
nodes.rationale: Inserts 'Tabata 20/10' and 'Classic HIIT 40/20' the first time the store is empty so the app isn't blank on first launch.

nodes.label: RunScreen Keep-Awake & Finish Flow
nodes.rationale: Full-screen run view sets isIdleTimerDisabled, runs a 3s pre-roll, and on finish shows confetti + random encouragement with Done and 'Repeat workout' (rebuilds the engine; each completion inserts its own Session). Ending early records nothing.

nodes.label: Warm-up / Cool-down Once-Only Segments
nodes.rationale: warmupSeconds/cooldownSeconds on Workout are once-only segments (0 = off) that run before round 1 and after the last round rather than per round; they don't count toward rounds.

nodes.label: Release Version-Bump Process
nodes.rationale: Releasing means bumping MARKETING_VERSION / CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION in project.yml (then xcodegen generate) and updating the version table + 'What's New' in docs/app-store-connect-info.md.
